raw_format: TSV; all supplied cell strings preserved, only quoting and whitespace separators normalized
training_membership: External probe only; not added to frozen v1 train/calibration/test
question: 根据以下日志数据判断系统是否存在异常

decision_labels.confirmed_abnormal: 已有足够证据确认阀冷系统发生设备故障、真实泄漏或保护异常。
decision_labels.expected_transition: 已有足够证据确认这是符合控制逻辑的风机调节与短时屏蔽，所给事件过程未见异常。
decision_labels.insufficient_evidence: 现有日志或资料不足以在前两种结论中确定一项，需要补充相关状态或适用控制逻辑。

evidence_scope: Retrieved regulation extracts only; no analyst conclusion or timing features added to model inputs
notes: New task schema, unlike training blocking/next_check
All three cyclic option-key permutations are probed
No field-validated label or operating context supplied
Numeric alarm_level 3 is not mapped to a severity label
